recommendation:
Build one cross-vault, generated **route layer**, then make semantic promotion event-driven. A global dispatcher discovers directories containing `index.md`+`log.md` (no hand list), and every 10 minutes runs cheap detection. It invokes promotion only when the computed backlog is nonzero, the repo is clean, and `log.md` has been quiet for 10 minutes; nightly remains only a recovery sweep. This approximates end-of-session without a fragile session marker and preserves the Git/filesystem trigger rule (`concepts/bc-wiki-maintain/CONCEPT.md:21-24`). Extend the date parser to accept exact bare `## YYYY-MM-DD` headings, preserving the heading verbatim; the current regex only dates bracketed headings (`body/wiki_lint.py:15,31-48`), which blocks sql and Scripts (`vault-reality.md:198-210`).

Add `wiki_route.py`. It incrementally builds disposable `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/bc-agent-wiki/<repo-id>/route.sqlite` from eligible Markdown: path, H1, ≤50-word summary, headings, aliases, Git date, dirty flag, and resolved in/out links. Freshness is checked on every query by recomputing source fingerprints; no agent-maintained marker exists. The first agent move is `wiki_route.py <vault> "<question>" --limit 3`, returning at most 350 tokens: three paths, matched headings/summaries, Git dates, and up to two neighbors each. Use local SQLite FTS/BM25; fall back to `rg`, then optional qmd only on low confidence. This replaces loading a 4,543-token index and avoids the measured 67.077-second hybrid query (`vault-reality.md:66,167`).

Reachability means “present in the generated catalog,” not “has an inbound prose link.” Make catalog omissions fatal; keep zero-inbound as advisory because legitimate leaf/archive pages exist. Require each new compiled page to have one semantically chosen context edge; automatic linking only proposes top candidates and never writes them. Standardize **future** internal links on explicit relative Markdown paths, while continuing to parse both syntaxes; do not rewrite Music’s wikilinks. Use labeled `Evidence:` Markdown links for source edges. The detector already parses both and computes inbound links (`body/wiki_lint.py:8-9,67-121,300-337`).

New/changed compiled pages must have H1, an opening `> Summary:` ≤50 words, evidence references, and ≤2,000 tokens; oversized pages trigger lint and an explicitly scoped split, never automatic rewriting. Raw/log/session material is exempt. Do not add dates: the router renders Git dates, preserving the no-drifting-frontmatter decision (`CONCEPT.md:38-40`; `body/SKILL.md:93-95`). Legacy pages get deterministic excerpt fallback plus `summary missing`; promotion may append a dated current synopsis, but broad migration remains separate (`CONCEPT.md:92-95`).

Keep all three gates unchanged. Route/cache work is read-only and untracked. More frequent promotion is still constrained by clean-tree checks, exact classification, Markdown-only output, prefix-additivity, and wrapper-owned dedicated commit (`body/runner/run-promotion.sh:42-51,102-125,188-247`); mutually exclusive claims still go to open questions (`body/SKILL.md:144-163`). Build router+benchmark first, then discovery/dispatcher, bare-date support, page-contract lint, and finally link suggestions. Success number: median **tokens from question to first gold-page path**, over a fixed cross-vault query set, with misses charged the whole eligible vault; target <400.

evidence.claim: The current read path is the largest practical defect: index traversal costs thousands of tokens and designated hybrid search takes over a minute.
Broken-link correctness does not imply reachability: live vaults have zero broken/ambiguous links but 7–21 orphans and nonzero index omissions.
Brain supports a compact routed working set and distinguishes context from evidence edges; it does not establish exact page-size or cadence thresholds.

assumptions.assumption: SQLite FTS over at most hundreds of eligible local pages can meet the proposed interactive latency and top-3 retrieval quality.
The existing safety wrapper mechanically enforces clean tree, classification coverage, Markdown-only writes, additivity, and dedicated commits.
A clean tree plus 10 minutes of log quiet is an adequate computed proxy for session completion across these workflows.

risks: Lexical routing may miss conceptual synonyms; benchmark before disabling qmd as fallback.
A cache under XDG is machine-local and must self-rebuild after clone or cache loss.
A strict 2,000-token cap may not fit architecture maps or specifications; exemptions need owner policy.
More frequent polling may repeatedly report permanent blockers unless bare-date support and failure visibility ship first.

confidence.reason: The diagnosis and safety fit are directly evidenced, but retrieval quality, latency target, quiet-period cadence, and page cap require measurement.

challengeClaims: A generated all-page catalog is not “another stale index” if every query recomputes its source fingerprint and the cache is disposable; show a concrete stale state that survives that check.
Zero-orphan enforcement improves decisions: demonstrate that forcing inbound prose links to every legitimate leaf/archive page improves retrieval rather than adding noise.
Nightly semantic batch is superior to computed post-session dispatch: explain why it will clear the measured backlogs when only 4/9 vaults currently have promotion timers.
ownerDecisions: Approve a machine-local generated cache and global vault discovery under configured parent roots.
Choose the compiled-page cap/exemptions; 2,000 tokens is a proposed starting point, not source-backed.
Choose whether qmd remains a low-confidence semantic fallback or is removed from the project read path after benchmarking.
changeMyMind: A benchmark showing `qmd search` or another existing command reaches ≥90% gold-page Recall@3 in <1 second and ≤350 output tokens across all nine vaults.
Evidence that content-fingerprint validation still permits stale route results after normal Git/dirty-tree workflows.
A pressure test showing frequent event-driven promotion defeats an existing gate or creates materially worse commits than nightly batching.
